title: ADR-007: Measure test strength with a mutation gate; reuse the adversarial-mutation-test skill, probe in Node
summary: Proposed decision to measure test strength on changed lines with a deterministic mutation gate, reusing the adversarial-mutation-test skill and a Node probe.
notes: Status reads Proposed, so locked is false despite the ADR type. Type and precedence came from the manifest. Cross-ref anchors (#enforcement-coverage-matrix, #checks-and-probes-run-sandboxed, #plugins-skills-and-mcp) stripped from paths. The SHA-256 source_hash suffix could not be computed (no shell or hashing tool available to this classifier), so this file is named without the hash suffix; the orchestrator must rename it to {slug}-{first 8 hex of SHA-256 of the POSIX source path}.json.
